answer.says: Shri Hegde, you have your liberty in your own quarters. I shall take my breakfast here; the morning air is too thick to invite a guest, and the walk to Lodhi will wait for a clearer sky.
answer.thought: He retreats into his private sphere, asserting the sovereignty of his own will over the bureaucratic necessity of the move. It is a small, stubborn act of freedom, yet it leaves me with the immediate, universal need for sustenance. I will eat.
